definitions.gloss: health maintenance; maintaining one's health; staying healthy
definitions.explanation: The practice of preserving and sustaining good health through lifestyle choices such as exercise, diet, and medical checkups.

notes:
The practice of preserving good health through lifestyle choices. A very common concept in Japanese health discourse.
